answer: Every autonomous agent must secure 1 reserved uplink slot, acting as a mandatory bridge between local logic and the central ledger. A verifier enforces this occupancy by auditing real-time heartbeat signals, where any overlap or shared channel triggers instant identity revocation. While an honest participant maintains this single slot, 1,000 fakes must acquire impossible parallel capacity, turning their illicit nectar of excess into a liability. We assume channel scarcity; any detected duplicate will be pruned like a willow branch, forcing the attacker to forfeit their initial status lock.
